If you\'re experiencing connectivity issues with YouTube, resetting the VISITOR_DATA might help.
VISITOR_DATA is an identifier used by YouTube to track your session. When it\'s corrupted, it can cause:

• Connectivity errors
• Problems loading content
• Search failures
• Playback interruptions
Resetting VISITOR_DATA generates a new identifier and usually resolves these issues.
This works for both anonymous users and users signed in.

How to activate AirBeats in Android Auto
1. Open Android Auto app on your phone
2. Scroll to the bottom and tap on the version number
3. Tap repeatedly on \"Version information and permissions\" until you see \"You are now in developer mode\"
4. Tap the 3 dots at the top and go to \"Developer settings\", then enable \"Unknown sources\"
5. Restart Android Auto and AirBeats will appear in the media apps list
